parsed.claim_reason: Greedy minimality forces only that P(a_{n+1}) hits every earlier prime set; extra prime factors are allowed. E.g. from any start where 2 divides all terms, a term like 6={2,3} or 10={2,5} properly contains the hitting set {2}, so inclusion-minimality fails.
parsed.witness_reason: Arithmetic checks: gcd(9,8)=1 so 9 is skipped, a_3=10; family {{2,3},{2}} is hit by {2}, a proper subset of {2,5}, so {2,5} is non-minimal. Caveat: it presumes the sequence may start 6,8; the same failure occurs for other starts (2,4,6), so the conclusion stands.
